firewall: Neutral verified facts and evidence links only. No certification impact or threshold recommendation.

intakes.fitness_classification: Useful for discovery and prioritization; not independently sufficient to support a legal claim, legal status, date, numerical limit, or certification consequence.

Primary PDFs support instrument identity, draft status, dates, printed analyte labels, and the figures quoted in the verification notes. Those figures are not regulatory_limit rows. Discovery notes and MANIFEST labels are candidate information and are not authority.

events.title: EU adds inorganic-arsenic maximum levels for fish and seafood

verification.notes: Official Journal instrument and HMI limit rows verified; iAs and total-arsenic salt rows remain distinct.

events.summary: Regulation (EU) 2025/1891 amended the EU contaminant framework with species-specific inorganic-arsenic maximum levels for aquatic foods and restated a separate total-arsenic limit for salt.

events.title: EU nickel maximum levels reach their second application date

verification.notes: Most rows applied from 2025-07-01; specified cereal rows apply from 2026-07-01.

events.summary: The EU nickel instrument is already in force; its cereal-group transition ended on 1 July 2026, later than the application date for most other listed foods.

events.title: China publishes GB 2762-2025 with a September 2026 effective date
product_scopes: foods placed on the Chinese market

verification.notes: Official announcement and preserved standard confirm publication and effective date. The existing 2022 HMI page records the scheduled supersession; no 2025 numerical value is duplicated here.

events.summary: GB 2762-2025 has been published and is scheduled to replace GB 2762-2022 on 2 September 2026; it is not treated as currently binding before that date.

events.title: GSO publishes active GSO 2783:2025 heavy-metals-in-food record
product_scopes: foods within the GSO technical-regulation scope

verification.notes: The official GSO record verifies the identity, active catalog status, publication date, technical-regulation class, broad scope, and listed analytes. The licensed tables and member-state implementing dates are not inferred from the catalog.

events.summary: GSO's official catalog verifies GSO 2783:2025 as an active technical-regulation record published on 29 October 2025 for heavy metals in food; national adoption dates must still be checked by GCC member state.
gaps: Licensed table transcription and member-state implementation dates remain internal follow-up items and are not public legal claims.

events.title: US states add baby-food testing and disclosure duties
product_scopes: infant formula where state text applies

official_sources.title: Illinois SB0073 bill status and Public Act record

verification.notes: The cluster is limited to the three official state records cited. Other state claims in the intake remain outside this verified summary.

events.summary: Virginia, Illinois, and Vermont official records show state-level testing, disclosure, and product-scope duties that operate alongside federal FDA guidance.
gaps: Reconcile any additional state bills mentioned by secondary trackers before adding them to the public comparison.

events.title: India adopts fish-oil inorganic-arsenic and pulse-flour changes for December 2026
authorities: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India

verification.notes: The final Gazette text and official FSSAI Amendment 17 register verify the 1 December 2026 effective date, pulse-flour scope changes, 0.1 mg/kg iAs fish-oil maximum, and total-arsenic screening sequence.

events.summary: FSSAI Amendment 17 applies from 1 December 2026, extends existing lead and cadmium pulse limits to pulse flours, and applies a 0.1 mg/kg inorganic-arsenic maximum to fish oils with total arsenic used only as the first screen.

events.title: Korea, Taiwan, and Hong Kong update Asian testing and contaminant controls
authorities: Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
Hong Kong Centre for Food Safety
product_scopes: foods tested by the amended method

official_sources.title: Hong Kong CFS metallic contamination amendment hub

verification.notes: Three official sources support separate changes; the combined event must not imply a common legal instrument or common effective date.

events.summary: Korea added a cadmium criterion for cocoa/chocolate, Taiwan amended an official analytical method, and Hong Kong brought an expanded Cap. 132V schedule into operation with a grace period.

events.title: Codex CAC48 adopts lead maximum levels for dried spices and herbs

official_sources.title: FAO/WHO report on CAC48 adopted standards

verification.notes: Codex adoption is an international standard, not automatically domestic binding law.

events.summary: CAC48 adopted lead maximum levels for dried bark spices and dried culinary herbs for incorporation into Codex CXS 193.

events.title: Brazil's infant-food limits are in force while MERCOSUR Project 07/23 remains under consultation
product_scopes: foods within the proposed MERCOSUR contaminant framework

verification.notes: Brazil's IN 351/2025 component is in force. The official MERCOSUR record verifies Project 07/23 and its internal-consultation status, so the combined event remains non-binding at the regional level.

events.summary: Brazil's amended infant-food lead limit is already in force; the official MERCOSUR record separately shows Project Resolution 07/23, intended to replace regional contaminant resolutions, still in internal consultation.

events.title: Canada revises permitted uses of aluminum-based food additives

official_sources.title: Health Canada Notice of Modification M-FAA-25-03

verification.notes: This is an additive-use authorization change, not a contaminant concentration limit and not a direct contaminant-limit row.

events.summary: Health Canada modified permitted uses of certain aluminum-based food additives; most changes took effect in October 2025 and one removal has a 2028 transition.

events.title: Vietnam's QCVN 20-1:2024/BYT health-supplement metal limits are in force
product_scopes: health supplements containing seaweed or bivalve ingredients

official_sources.title: Vietnam Official Gazette record for Circular 12/2024/TT-BYT

verification.notes: The signed Official Gazette PDF verifies the instrument, 1 August 2025 effective date, health-supplement scope, separate total/inorganic arsenic values, conditional cadmium tiers, lead, and total mercury limits.

events.summary: Circular 12/2024/TT-BYT made QCVN 20-1:2024/BYT effective on 1 August 2025 for health supplements, with separate total- and inorganic-arsenic limits, conditional cadmium tiers, lead, and total-mercury limits.

events.title: ECHA submits a proposed restriction for chromium(VI) substances
product_scopes: chromium(VI) substances and specified uses under REACH

official_sources.title: ECHA proposes restrictions on chromium(VI) substances

verification.notes: The Annex XV restriction remains a proposal/consultation and is not represented as binding law.

events.summary: ECHA's chromium(VI) Annex XV work is a REACH restriction proposal under consultation, not a food limit, drinking-water MCL, or occupational PEL.

events.title: FDA publishes large infant-formula testing results and schedules 2026 contaminant work
product_scopes: foods for babies and young children

official_sources.title: FDA 2026 Human Foods Program priority deliverables

verification.notes: Testing results and planned work do not themselves create a new binding limit.

events.summary: FDA released infant-formula testing data and identified 2026 work toward cadmium and inorganic-arsenic action levels; neither item is treated as a new binding limit.

events.title: EPA Lead and Copper Rule Improvements move toward 2027 compliance

official_sources.title: EPA Lead and Copper Rule Improvements

verification.notes: The rule is effective, but the principal compliance date is in 2027; this drinking-water duty is not a food concentration limit.

events.summary: EPA's LCRI establishes drinking-water inventory, monitoring, communication, and replacement duties with a major 2027 compliance date.
gaps: The intake's separate chromium risk-assessment and MATS claims require their own instrument-level verification and are not included in this event summary.

events.title: California hexavalent-chromium drinking-water compliance phases by system size
authorities: California State Water Resources Control Board

verification.notes: Cr-VI is retained as a speciated analyte and not converted from total chromium.

events.summary: California's enforceable Cr(VI) drinking-water MCL is in force, with system-size compliance dates running from 2026 through 2028.

events.title: EU packaging composition and mercury-product restrictions cross 2025-2026 deadlines

official_sources.title: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation overview

verification.notes: Two separate legal instruments are grouped only as a deadline watch. Packaging composition and mercury-added products are not food contaminant limits.

events.summary: The PPWR generally applies from 12 August 2026, while the revised Mercury Regulation phases restrictions across dental amalgam and specified lamps on separate dates.

events.title: EU lead ammunition and fishing-tackle restriction remains proposed

official_sources.title: ECHA lead in shot, bullets and fishing weights

verification.notes: The outdoor-shooting/fishing measure remains a proposed REACH restriction; the separate wetland gunshot restriction is already in force and must not be conflated with it.

events.summary: ECHA and Commission records support an ongoing proposed restriction for lead in outdoor shooting and fishing; it is not represented as an adopted general ban.

events.title: UK and EU prepare a dynamically aligned SPS area
product_scopes: agri-food products and relevant food-safety legislation

verification.notes: Negotiations remain ongoing. Dynamic alignment is an intended architecture, not yet a final binding contaminant instrument.

events.summary: The UK and EU are negotiating a common SPS area based on dynamic alignment, with official business guidance targeting mid-2027 while preserving that exact timing and exceptions remain subject to negotiation.

events.title: China food-safety standards pipeline remains active
product_scopes: foods and food-safety national standards under consultation

verification.notes: The official register supports an active standards pipeline. It does not support the intake's unverified details for individual draft metal limits.

events.summary: China's official NHC consultation register shows continuing food-safety standards work; individual draft contaminant claims require instrument-level verification before publication.
gaps: Extract and verify any metal-specific draft only when its official consultation attachment is identified.

events.title: Claimed Thailand 2025 food-contact change requires primary verification

verification.notes: Existing official packaging rules are accessible, but no official 2025 change matching the intake's claimed migration update was identified.

product_scopes: consumer products claimed in the intake

events.summary: G/TBT/N/VNM/451 circulates draft QCVN xx:2026/BCT for fresh rice noodle products. Part II clause 3, Bảng 2, prints maximum levels for lead, arsenic, cadmium, and mercury. Proposed adoption and application are to be determined. The text is a draft.
